label: Abandoned horse in the forest - AGG 2025
title: Abandoned horse in the forest
description: Arriving at a clearing, the feeble light of dawn reveals a noble steed. Although richly bridled, there is no trace of a rider. Perhaps the lonely rider has lost his way, or was captured by the king of elves? Carefully approaching the horse, Sasha is unnerved by the distant sound of singing female voices.
question_A: The character ignores the distant singing sounds and walks away  from the clearing.
question_B: Intrigued by  the monotonous sounds, resembling the repetitive, yet mesmerizing, experience of church litanies, the character decides to dive again into the woods, eager to reveal the source of the singing.

label: Ancient grave - AGG 2025
title: Ancient grave
description: Wandering through the graveyard, a lone sepulchre draws the attention of our character. A decayed statue depicting a knight in armour has suffered centuries of erosion; a shadow of its former glory. The epitaph on the tomb tells the tale of a nobleman of old, tragically departing from our world on the day of his marriage.

label: Danse macabre - AGG 2025
title: Danse macabre
goes_to: Telling own story with a song - AGG 2025
Falling unconscious from undead encounter - AGG 2025
music: Die Geister am Mummelsee IHW 22 n. 47
description: The character witnesses a group of ghosts carrying a grave into a lake.
question_B: The character tries to rebuke the undead, reciting a prayer while holding a holy  symbol.
goes_to_B: Falling unconscious from undead encounter - AGG 2025
question_C: Driven by primordial fear, the character flees from the ghost, driven by the ancestral terror for the uncanny. In the distance, an indistinguishable lonely figure seems to be the sole hope remaining.

label: Daydreaming about eternal love - AGG 2025
title: Daydreaming about eternal love
description: Cheerful songbirds and blooming flowers appear. The appearance of spring brings comfort and hope to our character. But are the comforts of nature and the dreams of the beloved only an illusion?
question_A: The character proceeds to the prefixed rendezvous, a lonely  milestone lying at a crossroad at the edge of the great forest, confident to meet their loved one there.
question_B: This brief journey  has irreversibly  altered their spirit, leading to doubt and despair. Their beloved one has forgotten them, or even worse, did not survive the perilous quest.

label: Demonic deception - AGG 2025
title: Demonic deception
goes_to: Demons keep the lovers apart - AGG 2025
description: The strange bird disappears from Sasha’s view. Suddenly, a hooded figure appears from the point at which the bird vanished. The wanderer is revealed as Ymir, a lady with pale skin and untamed scarlet curls.
question_A: The character feels uneasy  and tries to leave their new companion, realizing that Ymir has fallen in love with them.
question_B: The character is charmed by  the unnatural beauty  of Ymir, desperately  falling in love with them.
goes_to_B: Demons keep the lovers apart - AGG 2025

label: Demons keep the lovers apart - AGG 2025
title: Demons keep the lovers apart
change_spotlight: Despair and homesickness. Giving up their dreams - AGG 2025
music: Der Tod und das Mädchen D.531
description: The charming figure of Ymir leads Sasha to a ruined castle in the woods. As the gates of the castle open, a beautiful, brightly-lit garden is revealed. Fair ladies and courtiers of a forgotten time entice Sasha to join them. Sasha forgets all of their worries and the memory of their beloved Rune is merely a distant echo.
goes_to_A: Despair and homesickness. Giving up their dreams - AGG 2025

label: Despair and homesickness. Giving up their dreams - AGG 2025
title: Despair and homesickness. Giving up their dreams
music: Ich stand in dunklen Traümen Op. 13 n.1
description: After the horrifying experiences of the last hours, our character has despaired completely. Returning to the awful circumstances at home seems a better  choice than remaining here.
question_A: While taking the road back to civilization, a distant figure attracts the character’s attention. Could it be their beloved one?
question_B: The agents of Rune’s evil tutor have found them, leaving Sasha only  with traces of horse hooves on the muddy  road,  and a fallen amulet, once being the symbol of their eternal promise of love.

label: Elf of the woods creates charming illusion - AGG 2025
title: Elf of the woods creates charming illusion
music: Bedeckt mich mit Blumen IHW 32 n. 36
description: Walking through the thick undergrowth, Sasha hears the sound of a small brook. While slaking their thirst, Sasha notices the ethereal sounds of an ancient song. The indistinguishable words of the song lead Sasha to a state of enchantment. While losing consciousness, a fairylike creature emerges from the water.

label: Falling asleep - AGG 2025
title: Falling asleep
comes_from: Elf of the woods creates charming illusion - AGG 2025
description: The realm of consciousness is succeeded by the dimension of dreams. Exhausted, Sasha falls into deep sleep. Lying on a carpet of fallen leaves, Sasha is at the mercy of the elements and any hostile beings who may appear.

label: Falling unconscious from undead encounter - AGG 2025
title: Falling unconscious from undead encounter
description: The confrontation with the ancient spirit of the fallen knight tests Rune’s nerves and faith. Visions of their own sorrows and vicissitudes resonate with the knight’s tragic fate. They are joined by other spirits, who dance around them in mockery and slowly begin to drain their life-force.

label: Following path and getting lost - AGG 2025
title: Following path and getting lost
goes_to: Reaching higher ground during a storm - AGG 2025
description: Sasha follows the path through the gloomy forest. Every shadow or sound is turned into an ill omen of terror by the impenetrable darkness of the night. But love drives the steps of our character forward, surmounting their ancestral fear.
goes_to_A: Reaching higher ground during a storm - AGG 2025

label: Happy ending - AGG 2025
title: Happy ending
comes_from: Despair and homesickness. Giving up their dreams - AGG 2025
description: Sasha and Rune are finally reunited. There are no words to describe their endless joy. A bright future awaits them, and if they haven’t died, they are still living happily together. “Und wenn sie nicht gestorben sind, dann leben sie noch heute”.

label: Lonely man is burying a coffin - AGG 2025
title: Lonely man is burying a coffin
goes_to: Telling own story with a song - AGG 2025
comes_from: Seek shelter in abandoned monastery - AGG 2025
description: Amidst the ruins, Rune is woken by the faint light of dawn. From one of the surviving gothic windows, Rune sees a lonely figure digging a deep hole in the nearby graveyard. Rune decides to ask the only living being in the castle for directions.
goes_to_A: Telling own story with a song - AGG 2025

label: Meeting the Witch - AGG 2025
title: Meeting the Witch
goes_to: Recognition of the evil sorceress - AGG 2025
comes_from: Abandoned horse in the forest - AGG 2025
description: After a night spent wandering, the dawn begins to break. A flock of crows suddenly darkens the early morning sky, and then disperses, leaving only a single bird behind. Sasha has the feeling that this bird is looking back at them with almost human intelligence.
question_A: The character is exhausted by  the incessant journey  and throws a pebble to drive away  the animal.
question_B: The character is intrigued by  the marvellous bird and leaves them a breadcrumb before proceeding on their path.
goes_to_A: Recognition of the evil sorceress - AGG 2025

label: Mistrust of animals - AGG 2025
title: Mistrust of animals
goes_to: Abandoned horse in the forest - AGG 2025
description: Sasha suddenly wakes up, realising that exhaustion had led them to fall asleep in the middle of the forest. Dawn brings a feeling of unease to our character. Mistrusting and invisible eyes keep watch while Sasha prepares to depart.
goes_to_A: Abandoned horse in the forest - AGG 2025

label: Moonlight -  AGG 2025
title: Moonlight
goes_to: Despair and homesickness. Giving up their dreams - AGG 2025
comes_from: Recognition of the evil sorceress - AGG 2025
description: As the clouds disperse, our character finds shelter in a shepherd’s hut. Through the missing roof, it is possible to gaze at the beautiful waxing moon, while the sun slowly rises in the east. In the distance, our character sees the crossroads where they had planned to meet their beloved.
question_A: The character decides to take a short break in the hut, to gather the last forces.
question_B: The enthusiasm of youth drives the character in the meadows, walking on a steady  pace in the direction of the milestone.
goes_to_B: Despair and homesickness. Giving up their dreams - AGG 2025

label: Prayer of the Hermit - AGG 2025
title: Prayer of the Hermit
comes_from: Telling own story with a song - AGG 2025
music: Gedichte der Königin Maria Stuart Op.135 n.5
description: After having listened to Rune’s story, the hermit recites a prayer in a low and solemn tone. The words of the invocation reveal a glimpse of Vanadis’s past, echoing the same miseries of our character’s love story. Rune regains strength and faith. After some kind words of farewell, they resume their journey.

label: Reaching higher ground during a storm - AGG 2025
title: Reaching higher ground during a storm
change_spotlight: Seek shelter in abandoned monastery - AGG 2025
comes_from: Following path and getting lost - AGG 2025
description: Rain has been falling incessantly since Sasha’s departure. The path is inaccessible, and Sasha has lost their way. Their only chance is to climb the nearest hill in order to attain a new sense of orientation. Fighting against the rain and wind, Sasha realises that the storm is intensifying.
question_A: Regardless of the weather, Sasha stubbornly proceeds in their march through the woods.
question_B: What seems to be an abandoned natural cave could be a safe, and relatively  dry  place to pass the night.
goes_to_C: Seek shelter in abandoned monastery - AGG 2025

label: Recognition of the evil sorceress - AGG 2025
title: Recognition of the evil sorceress
description: After being hit by the pebble, the strange bird emits a sharp sound like a woman’s scream. Is it possible? Instead of a bird, Sasha is confronted by a furious witch with pale skin and scarlet curls. Shrieking curses in an unknown language, the figure approaches. Sasha runs away as fast as possible.

label: Sad ending - AGG 2025
title: Sad ending
comes_from: Despair and homesickness. Giving up their dreams - AGG 2025
music: Wie viele Zeit verlor Ich IHW 15 n. 37
description: The quest has failed: their love could not prevail against ill fate. Rune is destined to wed the old bachelor, imposed by their tutor, while a life of misery and regret will attend Sasha… The lovers are parted for eternity.

label: Seek shelter in abandoned monastery - AGG 2025
title: Seek shelter in abandoned monastery
goes_to: Lonely man is burying a coffin - AGG 2025
description: Rune manages to find refuge in an old monastery, by opening the rusty old gate of the building. Empty halls tell forgotten tales of countless generations of nuns and their seclusion. Rune falls asleep in an austere cell.
goes_to_B: Lonely man is burying a coffin - AGG 2025

label: Staying awake - AGG 2025
title: Staying awake
comes_from: Reaching higher ground during a storm - AGG 2025
description: Despite muddy boots and wet clothes, Sasha continues to strive against the stormy weather. Maintaining a steady pace, the trail gradually becomes clearer. In the distance, the old estate is visible. Sasha’s thoughts of their beloved are a guiding star leading them tirelessly onwards.

label: Taking a "shortcut" - AGG 2025
title: Taking a "shortcut"
goes_to: Elf of the woods creates charming illusion - AGG 2025
description: According to their grandfather, an abandoned game trail should still be traceable, potentially saving several hours of travel. In leaving the security of the main road in favour of the unknown, Sasha turns their back to their former life to pursue a nobler goal.
goes_to_A: Elf of the woods creates charming illusion - AGG 2025

label: Telling own story with a song - AGG 2025
title: Telling own story with a song
comes_from: Lonely man is burying a coffin - AGG 2025
description: The lonely figure, a Hermit by the name of Vanadis, is leading Rune to their abandoned chapel. Once arrived, the Hermit breaks their silence to offer Rune some rustic refreshment. Rune decides to repay the Hermit’s hospitality by telling their tale of thwarted love and great misfortune.

label: Wandering through the forest - AGG 2025
title: Wandering through the forest
goes_to: Following path and getting lost - AGG 2025
music: Dunkel wie dunkel in Wald und in Feld Op. 43 n.1
description: At the boundaries of the ancient forest, a lonely traveller advances on a desolate road. Sasha has left the safety of their native village in order to rescue their beloved Rune from an unwilling marriage. Staring at the impenetrable darkness of the woods, they realise how hard it will be to reach the other side by dawn…
question_A: A smaller path lies more or less parallel to the main road, heading towards the right direction. It could be worth trying…
question_B: According to their grandfather, further down the main road an abandoned game trail should save several hours of journey. But will its trails still be present after years of overgrowing?
goes_to_A: Following path and getting lost - AGG 2025

label: Wandering through the ruins - AGG 2025
title: Wandering through the ruins
goes_to: Seek shelter in abandoned monastery - AGG 2025
music: Wie rafft ich mich auf Op. 32 n.1
description: Rune arrives at an abandoned summer estate, a desolate castle once the splendor of a noble family. Rain has been falling incessantly, having helped Rune’s escape from their greedy tutor. While wandering through the ruins, Rune seeks a refuge for the night.
question_A: One of the buildings, inspiring solidity  and endurance typical of gothic architecture, seems a good place to rest and seek shelter. Would the rusty  gate of the main entrance still be open?
question_B: The shelter of a small crypt in the old family  graveyard appears to be the best place to hide, in case any  pursuer would have tracked their steps to here.
goes_to_A: Seek shelter in abandoned monastery - AGG 2025

label: Witch's love enchantment - AGG 2025
title: Witch's love enchantment
goes_to: Despair and homesickness. Giving up their dreams - AGG 2025
description: Ymir, exhausted by the futility of trying to persuade Sasha to forget their lover, becomes enraged. Ymir’s charming facade disintegrates, and they utter primordial and mysterious syllables - an ancient language lost to the memory of man. An ancestral enchantment is binding  Sasha’s soul to the power of Ymir.
question_A: The character resists the witch’s charms, closing their eyes and drawing on their faith and will in order to protect them from dark practices. A silence, then the silent wood and a bright ray  of morning sun, leading the way  to the end of the forest.
question_B: The witch’s words pervades the character’s mind with horrendous visions and untellable horrors. After regaining consciousness, the character finds themselves alone in the woods.
goes_to_B: Despair and homesickness. Giving up their dreams - AGG 2025

label: Witches' ritual - AGG 2025
title: Witches' ritual
goes_to: Demons keep the lovers apart - AGG 2025
comes_from: Abandoned horse in the forest - AGG 2025
description: The strange and mesmerising litany leads Sasha to an ancient well surrounded by trees of great age. A group of hooded figures surround the mossy stones, drawing water from the well with a frayed rope. One figure turns towards Sasha, revealing pale skin, crimson hair, and a supernatural beauty. Ymir offers them a cup of the mystical liquid.
goes_to_A: Demons keep the lovers apart - AGG 2025
